title: Artificial Cerebrospinal Fluid I (ACSF.I)
author: Allen Institute for Brain Science
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bezkjf4w
materials: Calcium Chloride, dihydrate (CaCl2·2 H2O) (Sigma C3306, C3881 or equivalent)
D-Glucose (C6H12O6; aka Dextrose) (Sigma G7021, G8270 or equivalent)
Magnesium Sulfate, Heptahydrate (MgSO4·7 H2O) (Sigma M1880 or equivalent)
Sodium Phosphate monobasic monohydrate (NaH2PO4 • H2O) (Sigma S9638 or equivalent)
Potassium Chloride (KCl) (Sigma P9333, Sigma P5405, P4504 or equivalent)
Sodium L-Ascorbate (C6H7NaO6 ) (Sigma A7631, A4034 or equivalent)
Sodium Bicarbonate (NaHCO3) (Sigma S5761, S8875 or equivalent)
N-Methyl-D-glucamine (C7H17NO5) (Fluka 66930 purchased as Sigma M2004 or equivalent)
Myo inositol (C6H12O6) (Sigma I7508, I5125 or equivalent)
P200 pipette tips (Rainin GPL200F or equivalent)

steps.title: Prepare calcium chloride stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 29.4 g CaCl₂·2H₂O in 1 L MilliQ water in a labeled 1 L polystyrene bottle; store at room temperature (RT) for up to 60 days (200 mM stock).

steps.title: Prepare HEPES stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 238.3 g HEPES in 1 L MilliQ water in a labeled 1 L polystyrene bottle; store at RT for up to 60 days (1 M stock).

steps.title: Prepare magnesium sulfate stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 246 g MgSO₄·7H₂O in 1 L MilliQ water in a labeled 1 L polystyrene bottle; store at RT for up to 60 days (1 M stock).

steps.title: Prepare potassium‑phosphate‑magnesium stock
steps.instruction: In a labeled 1 L bottle, dissolve 18.6 g KCl in 1 L MilliQ water (250 mM). Add 17.3 g NaH₂PO₄·H₂O, then add 24.6 g MgSO₄·7H₂O; store at RT for up to 60 days (combined 250 mM KCl, 125 mM NaH₂PO₄, 100 mM MgSO₄).

steps.title: Prepare sodium pyruvate stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 55 g sodium pyruvate (CH₃COCOONa) in 1 L MilliQ water in a labeled 1 L bottle; store at 4 °C for up to 60 days (500 mM stock).

steps.title: Prepare taurine stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.625 g taurine in 50 mL MilliQ water in a labeled 50 mL conical tube; store at 4 °C for up to 60 days (100 mM stock).

steps.title: Prepare thiourea stock and aliquots
steps.instruction: Dissolve 6.08 g thiourea in 50 mL MilliQ water (1.6 M). Aliquot 1.4 mL into each of 35 labeled 1.7 mL microcentrifuge tubes; store at –20 °C for up to 60 days. Warm to RT before use.

steps.title: Label container and set up stirring
steps.instruction: Label a sterile 1 L polystyrene bottle with reagent name, date, and preparer’s initials; place a stir bar inside. Set up a stir plate in the fume hood.

steps.title: Determine ACSF volume to prepare
steps.instruction: Consult the reagent request form to decide whether to prepare 500 mL or 1 L of ACSF I; use Table 1 for required quantities.

steps.title: Combine water and add stock solutions
steps.instruction: Measure 500 mL MilliQ water with a graduated cylinder, add to the labeled bottle, and place on the stir plate (speed ≥ 7). Add the following using sterile serological pipettes or graduated cylinders: 20 mL 1 M HEPES stock, 10 mL 250 mM KCl/NaH₂PO₄/MgSO₄ stock, 6 mL 500 mM sodium pyruvate stock, 100 µL 100 mM taurine stock (P200), and 1.25 mL 1.6 M thiourea stock (room‑temperature).

steps.title: Add solid reagents
steps.instruction: Using a calibrated balance, weigh and add each solid while stirring: 4.51 g D‑glucose, 540 mg myo‑inositol, 1.96 g N‑acetyl‑L‑cysteine, 19.4 g N‑methyl‑d‑glucamide, 1.0 g sodium L‑ascorbate, and 2.1 g sodium bicarbonate. Add slowly to avoid splashing.

steps.title: Adjust pH to 7.3
steps.instruction: Measure pH with a calibrated pH meter; add 5 N HCl dropwise until pH = 7.3 (up to 16 mL HCl may be required).

steps.title: Add calcium and magnesium stocks
steps.instruction: Add 2.5 mL 200 mM calcium chloride stock and 9 mL 1 M magnesium sulfate stock using sterile serological pipettes.

steps.title: Finalize volume and check osmolarity
steps.instruction: Remove the stir bar with a magnetic remover. Adjust final volume to 1000 mL with MilliQ water (use container graduation marks or a graduated cylinder). Measure osmolarity of a 10 µL sample with an osmometer; if outside 300‑310 mOsm, adjust: add MilliQ water to lower, or add calculated volume X of 1 mg/mL NaCl (X = required volume) to raise. Re‑measure to confirm correct osmolarity.

steps.title: Filter ACSF solution
steps.instruction: Attach the Corning 1 L 0.45 µm filter system to the Gast vacuum pump using Tygon tubing; turn on the pump. Filter 500 mL of ACSF at a time while continuously stirring the remaining solution on the stir plate.

steps.title: Label final bottle and document
steps.instruction: Label the final bottle with reagent name, date, time, and preparer’s initials; note that ACSF expires one week from preparation. Record date, lot numbers of all components, and final osmolarity in the reagent preparation notebook.

steps.title: Cleanup and storage
steps.instruction: Dispose of excess reagent directly into the municipal sewer system. Wash the stir bar with MilliQ water. Store the finished ACSF at 4 °C; use fresh the day of use and within one week (or per investigator’s discretion).
